context.encoding: ASCII JSON ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon without whitespace, allow_nan=false; compare exact reencoded bytes; reject duplicates, unknown fields, noncanonical integers, unsafe strings and bool-as-int

calendar.target_session_schedule: scheduled_close_ns is int64 and early_close is bool, both exactly equal ConfigSpec.session fields; actual regular close<=scheduled_close_ns and early_close exactly equals actual regular close<scheduled_close_ns. These fields are included in the c1 calendar hash; no proof reused with changed scheduled close/flag.
calendar.ordering: sessions strict chronological unique; their IDs identical to actual ConfigSpec.window.governed_sessions and their bounds identical to actual worker governed IntervalSpec declarations; segments strict disjoint chronological with regular equal to actual ConfigSpec.session; no generated weekdays or OS timezone lookup

quality_projection.normal: existing Status/Reason only; malformed schema/order/unit/basis/overflow typed ContractError before any result
quality_projection.all_visible_reasons: Retain all independently applicable existing reasons in fixed lexical order; status precedence above chooses one status. No new gate reason inserted into legacy Reason enum.
quality_projection.status_max_age: Explicit max reject -> state null, missing_input/ineligible, admission unavailable/stale_state. Proven descriptive age remains available. No selected max -> no event-age expiry.
quality_projection.status_unknown: Unknown seed/prefix/validity/required transition -> state and current-state age null with original missing/coverage/knowledge reason; no last-observed-age fallback. Finite state/validity expiry -> missing_input/ineligible.
quality_projection.assessment: State/reason diagnostic outputs available with expected=observed=1 for a completed evaluation, even outcome unknown/failed. That is assessment readiness, not factual readiness. All source input bindings and excluded original facts retained.
quality_projection.classification_value: Passed gate -> actual selected nonblank membership text available; proved absence -> null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations; missing proof/population or late/unknown fact -> null with applicable missing-input reason; partial projection -> null/incomplete_coverage/governed_gap; known mismatch -> null/missing_input/ineligible.
quality_projection.gate_rule: Evaluate visible conditions; visible failed comparison wins over unknown prerequisites. Otherwise unknown prerequisites -> unknown, else passed. Scalar reason first in selected list; structural overlap/invalid identity remains error. Future knowledge is failed only when it is a directly evaluated active required fact or proof, never irrelevant future-effective rows.
quality_projection.numerical_coverage: For each numerical scalar expected/observed count its exact required field/slot population; zero-denominator/no-price statuses are independent from aggregate totals. Context declarations do not invent observed market completeness. Full metadata/source/known-at/evidence/config identity parity is required beyond numeric tolerance.

semantics_addenda.period_counts: scheduled_sessions counts all supplied governed sessions whose civil date lies within exact selected period; completed_sessions counts those with actual close<=C. Both depend on full causally admitted calendar proof, not price delivery, and can remain ready while period OHLC is missing. Current-period price aggregation uses only eligible sessions/prefix<=C, never future daily prices. A current period may contain supplied known future schedule definitions for scheduled count; they are calendar knowledge, not market observations.
semantics_addenda.period_completion: prior_complete requires entire selected period end_date_exclusive<=target_date and all selected regular sessions completed. current_to_cutoff uses completed earlier DAILY plus optional target BAR prefix only. A current-prefix at C=regular_open is an explicit no-observation contribution, no fake zero-width batch. Earlier covered period sessions still aggregate normally.
semantics_addenda.phase_zero_prefix: C<phase_start: selected extended values all null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations. C=phase_start: no market batch permitted; explicit mathematical zero-prefix branch gives volume/notional0 available expected=observed0, prices/returns null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations, using actual calendar proof only. No InputScope(start,start). C>phase_start uses actual positive-duration canonical batch scope.
semantics_addenda.anchor_cutoff: Require start<C. start=C or start>C -> typed ContractError BOUNDS. Positive-duration complete empty batch -> volume/notional0, VWAPnull/not_applicable/zero_denominator. Missing market delivery -> missing_input, never zero.
semantics_addenda.anchor_proof: Proof declaration admits exact supplied mathematical anchor; it does not authenticate selection history or claim a breakout algorithm computed the anchor. Threshold/policy-derived anchor selection remains EF8.
semantics_addenda.path_open: Use same complete canonical path batch to derive opening witness. TRADE: first eligible price under exact auction policy. BAR: first positive-volume bar.open, while samples are its completed closes. No duplicate cloned BAR IDs or separate hidden open scalar. Whole path prefix starts actual regular open.
semantics_addenda.gap: G=O-P; remaining=max(0,(last-P)/G); fill=max sampled clamp((O-x)/G,0,1); filled exists (x-P)*G<=0; first_fill timestamp first eligible hit. G0 makes all four gap-specific outputs not_applicable/zero_denominator. No hit -> first_fill null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations, filledFalse available. OHLC low alone is never a sampled close hit.
semantics_addenda.drive: Completed window[regular_open,open+duration), final sampled return last/O-1, up=max(0,maxsample/O-1),down=max(0,1-minsample/O). Trades at window end excluded, completed bars ending there admitted. No private strength threshold or episode state.
semantics_addenda.action_quantity: apply_factors expects actual raw representation and actual raw_shares source basis; output policy may request split_shares and accepted utility transforms explicitly. caller_transformed expects actual caller_transformed and source quantity exactly requested output quantity basis. Gates do not apply factors and do not add a dividend twice. A requested transformed split-share output does not imply incoming raw volume was already split-adjusted.

fixture_notation.all_rows: Every row in fixture notation expands with instrument_id X/session S unless its literal prior-session ID is P. Row lists are CanonicalBatch column values in listed names, not new worker objects. Metadata SourceBinding/input_id and real row counts must be instantiated without substitutions. Reference proof relations target the actual named input_id.
fixture_notation.availability_default: For a literal fixture query with C and no K/E, K=C,E=C,known_at mode,reconstruction_reason null. Explicit query values override this test notation only; the public decoder invents no cutoffs.
fixture_notation.quality_default: All supplied required market/proof inputs in a positive fixture have eligible original known-at and complete exact scope. Every numerical/scalar value is available with empty reasons unless its explicit expected quality states otherwise. Calendar/anchor proof fixture IDs are the c1/a1 digest of the exact literal supplied definition, never a hash of an output.
fixture_notation.coverage_complete: Metadata Coverage(expected=literal rows,observed=literal rows,complete=true); status stream/prefix validity and population projection require their separate literal proof rows, never row-count inference.
fixture_notation.known_at_default: 5 only when fixture explicitly adopts this common source profile; null remains null, never defaulted after decoding
fixture_notation.exact_expectations: Rational strings below are independent mathematical expectations, not Float64 wire values. Implementation later compares its one Float64 conversion with tolerance1e-12; int/decimal coefficient/state/quality/reason/UTCns compare exactly. Proof hashes derive from frozen literal canonical definition bytes, not from a calculation output.
